rootCause: The policy module had already moved search construction into lazy ensure* functions, but buildIndexes still exposed cache slots named basicSearchTextByPolicy/vehicleSearchTextByPolicy inside the first-paint block. The B4-003 contract correctly treats that source shape as ambiguous first-paint search work.

fix.summary: Renamed lazy cache slots to basicSearchIndex and vehicleSearchIndex; the first-paint index remains relation-only, while search text continues to build only through ensureBasicSearchIndex and ensureVehicleSearchIndex.
